title: Senior Named Account Executive, Toronto
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p>Toronto, Ontatio</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>We are looking for a seasoned sales professional to cover large accounts in Canada, and are open to remote candidates in the Toronto and Montreal areas. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at all levels with technical and non-technical buyers.</li> <li>As an Senior Named Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan as well as driving sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets. The person in this role will also assist in creating and articulating compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations</li> <li>Maintain a robust sales pipeline</li> <li>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts</li> <li>Ensure customer satisfaction</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>A minimum 6 years of direct B2B experience selling security or networking products/solutions (cyber security, IaaS, PaaS, etc).</li> <li>A minimum 3 years selling to large enterprise accounts in Canada, specifically in the Toronto, Montreal or Vancouver markets</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles</li> <li>Deep understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (technical background in network engineering or computer science is a plus)</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced dynamic environment</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Technical Writer
description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence. In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes. Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander) Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update Interface & System Specifications Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines Operational & Field Documentation Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates Client-Facing title: Account Manager – Retention Specialist
description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Le contexte Les cabinets d’avocats indépendants représentent le segment qui connaît la plus forte croissance chez Doctrine, avec une hausse de 50 % sur les 12 derniers mois. Pour accompagner cette dynamique, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la fidélisation de nos clients et le développement de ton portefeuille. Nous recherchons un·e Account Manager (Retention Specialist) pour rejoindre notre équipe dédiée aux avocats indépendants. Tu seras responsable d’un portefeuille de plus de 800 clients, avec une priorité : leur donner envie de rester chez Doctrine. Identifier les opportunités business cross-sell et les transmettre aux Sales Specialists.. À propos de toi : Tu as une première expérience en vente ou en gestion de comptes B2B, avec des objectifs commerciaux. Tu aimes convaincre et négocier. Tu sais écouter une insatisfaction, répondre aux objections et chercher un accord. Tu es à l’aise au téléphone et prends volontiers l’initiative d’appeler tes clients. Tu sais gérer un portefeuille conséquent, choisir tes priorités et tenir tes engagements. Tu es curieux·se, tu apprends rapidement et tu sais expliquer simplement le fonctionnement d’un produit. Tu apprécies les retours pour progresser et tu partages tes conseils avec tes collègues. Tu t’exprimes clairement à l’oral comme à l’écrit, en français. Une formation ou une expérience juridique est un plus, mais n’est pas un prérequis. Pourquoi être AM/Growth Retention chez Doctrine ? Occuper un poste qui associe négociation commerciale, relation client et expertise produit, auprès d’avocats indépendants. Être responsable d’un portefeuille de clients significatif avec pour objectif de les fidéliser et de développer ce portefeuille. Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc. Nos valeurs 🤝 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses. description: <p><strong>Help Shape the Future of the UK's Energy Infrastructure</strong></p> <p>BakerHicks has established itself as a trusted engineering partner within the UK's Transmission & Distribution sector, delivering major infrastructure projects for some of the country's leading utility clients. key point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders. </p> <p>You will also support business development activities by contributing technical input to tender submissions and helping secure future project opportunities.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why This Role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work on some of the UK's most significant Transmission & Distribution projects.</li> <li>Be part of a from concept and design through to construction and energisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the specifications.</li> <li>LVAC systems for substations.</li> <li>Earthing studies and earth return current calculations.</li> <li>Insulation coordination studies.</li> <li>Mechanical interlocking schemes.</li> <li>Equipment technical specifications.</li> <li>Type registration documentation.</li> <li>Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Project submissions.</li> <li>Maintain updates to the Business Development Tracker.</li> <li>Participate in client meetings, design reviews and technical workshops.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About You:</strong></p> <p>You will be an experienced HV Substation Engineer with a strong technical background and a passion for delivering high-quality engineering solutions.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>You will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience delivering primary design and engineering for HV substation projects up to 400kV.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of UK Transmission and Distribution ability to work independently while supporting and developing others.</li> <li>A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>BEng or BSc in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.</li> <li>Extensive experience in HV substation primary design and engineering.</li> <li>Experience producing designs, calculations, reports and drawings associated with substation projects up to 400kV.</li> <li>Strong understanding of IEC standards and industry best practice.</li> <li>Experience working to National Grid and DNO specifications.</li> <li>Experience managing engineering teams and coordinating project delivery.</li> <li>Experience working alongside CAD technicians using AutoCAD, Revit or similar software.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Desirable Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>MEng or MSc in Electrical Engineering.</li> <li>National Grid HV Plant CDAE accreditation.</li> title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">A career that’s the whole package!</span></strong></p> <p>At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Conga</strong> lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.</span></p></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>Germany (remote)</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>RVP Sales</p> <p><strong>Languages: </strong>native/C2 level German and English</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>A Quick Snapshot…..</strong> </p> <p>As an Account Executive, you'll be at the forefront of our revenue growth strategy, spearheading efforts to uncover and nurture new business prospects while strengthening connections with our current clientele. Your role will involve deeply understanding client requirements, crafting personalized solutions, and ensuring top-notch customer satisfaction. Collaborating closely with Sales Engineering, Business/Sales Development, Marketing, Transformation Specialists, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partners and clients, your primary focus will be on prospecting, managing and closing new business opportunities for enterprise-wide CONGA solutions with organizations across a variety of key strategic industries/verticals in the B2B space.  </p> <p><strong>Why it’s big deal… </strong> </p> <p>You'll have the chance to sell high-impact, mission-critical projects with substantial value, driving transformational change for our clients in Central Europe. Your role will involve skillfully crafting and implementing territory, account, and opportunity plans to optimize revenue within your assigned selling patch. You'll expertly manage sales opportunities throughout every stage of the cycle, ensuring success for both our clients and our company. </p> <p><strong>Are you the person we are looking for? </strong> </p> <p><strong>Proven track record.</strong> You have at least 5 years successful B2B technology Enterprise sales experience in the SaaS industry, in Central Europe. </p> <ul> <li>Proficiency in revenue management principles is crucial. </li> <li>You have a consistent track record of over achieving quota and revenue targets.  </li> <li>You cultivate and leverage strategic relationships with partners to drive mutual business growth and success. </li> <li>Knowledge and experience in general AI and machine learning can bring significant value. You understand how AI can enhance revenue management processes. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Hunter mentality. </strong>You'll have the opportunity to unleash your inner hunter and drive our growth through relentless pursuit of new business opportunities. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, leveraging your strategic mindset and tenacity to identify, pursue, and close deals with potential clients. The focus is 90% new business. </p> <p><strong>Solution Selling. </strong>Collaborate with prospects and clients to understand their unique challenges and business goals. Present Conga's comprehensive suite of solutions and services that align with clients' needs, demonstrating a deep understanding of how Conga can provide value. <br><br><strong>Drive</strong>. You have the ability to successfully leverage resources and take initiative. The most successful Conga reps are the ones who stop at nothing to achieve success no matter the circumstance. </p> <p><strong>Communication</strong>: You have the ability to articulate complex technology concepts to a technical and non-technical audience. You also have superb listening skills and you understand objections and overcome them by turning skeptics into enthusiastic new customers and brand ambassadors. You possess Excellent written and verbal communication skills. </p> <p><strong>Growth Mindset</strong>. As the business landscape is constantly evolving you adapt to changes in market conditions, customer preferences, and competitive dynamics. You innovate and develop creative solutions to address challenges and capitalize on opportunities in the revenue management space. </p> <p><strong>Collaboration.</strong>  You'll work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver exceptional value to our clients and drive mutual success. Together, we'll leverage each other's expertise and insights to achieve our goals and surpass expectations. You have the gravitas to lead a winning team, leveraging the strengths and skills of the organization to deliver profitable business to the organization. </p> <p><strong>What will give you an edge...</strong> </p> <p>Experience selling Revenue Lifecycle Management solutions with a good understanding of CPQ, revenue optimization, CLM, doc-gen and e-signature products. </p> <p>Education and/or experience in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Accounting, Marketing, Finance, or Operations Research considered a plus.</p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-AM1</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Did we pique your interest? </strong> </p> <p>If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. <span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We'd love to hear from you! </span></p> <p><strong>Preferred Resume Format</strong> </p> <p>We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly. </p> <p><strong>Don’t meet every requirement for the role?</strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong> </p> <p>Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.  </p> <div> <section id="st-additionalInformation" class="job-section"> <div> <h2 class="title">Additional Information</h2> </div> <div class="wysiwyg"> <p>Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.</p> </div> </section> </div> <section class="job-apply print-hidden"></section> <p><strong>Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement </strong></p> <p>The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (<a href="https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement">https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement</a>). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager (JetBrains Context)
description: <p>Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.</li> <li>Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.</li> <li>Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.</li> <li>Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.</li> <li>Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.</li> <li>Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.</li> <li>Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.</li> <li>Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.</li> <li>Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.</li> <li>The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.</li> <li>Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.</li> <li>The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.</li> <li>The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.</li> <li>Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.</li> <li>Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.</p> <p>Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its governance and scale, and the market clearly understands its unique value because you've communicated it effectively.</p> <p><strong><br><br>Why join JetBrains? </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li>Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.</li> <li>Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.</li> <li>Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.</li> <li>Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.</li> <li>Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.</li> </ul> <p>*Some benefits may vary depending on location.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-HYBRID - if you <strong>want</strong> LinkedIn to post your role as hybrid in all the locations where the role is open ---> leave this tag in JD</span><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-AA1 </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the <a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/privacy/privacy-recruitment/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products. This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development. Based in Cologne, you'll be a key member of the Engineering team building IMPECT's customer-facing Scouting and Analytics platforms. You'll develop backend services and frontend features that help football clubs explore our data, evaluate players and teams, and analyse performance. Your work will span data-rich interfaces, interactive visualisations, integrated video tools, and workflows that support scouting and match analysis. Working closely with Product and fellow engineers, you'll translate customer needs into intuitive, reliable applications and help improve their performance and scalability as our platform grows. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll contribute to technical decisions and take ownership of features from initial design through to delivery, shaping the products our customers use every day. We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance. Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use. WHAT YOU'LL DO Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Build and maintain Angular web applications Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications Design and implement database schema Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems. Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains. Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform. WHAT YOU'LL NEED At least 5 years of software development experience. Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin Java. Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications Experience with Git code management is highly desired. Other Requirements: Very strong attention to detail. Proven self-starter. Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing. Ability to prioritise and a "can-do" attitude. title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process. This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both. How we're set up Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do. We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves. What you'll own Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible. The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours. Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself. A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so. Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad. Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth. Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it. How we expect leaders to operate Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems. Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line. End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally. No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it. Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against. Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions. Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too. What you bring 4 to 6+ years in engineering management , with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers. A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical. Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why. Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully. Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery. Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it. Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices : code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing. Strong pluses Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build. Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation. Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it. What this role is, and isn't It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package). Der Fokus liegt auf strategischer Einordnung und Beratung – nicht auf umfangreichen Präsentationen oder formalen Abstimmungen. Was uns unterscheidet, ist das Tempo. Wir arbeiten schlank und pragmatisch, mit klarer Verantwortung auf Kundenseite und intern. Wer Zusammenhänge schnell erfasst, Prioritäten setzt und Entscheidungen vorbereitet, kann hier viel bewegen. Deutschlandticket inklusive: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Ticket, damit du privat und beruflich entspannt unterwegs bist. Kostenlos Trainieren: Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du in unzähligen Gyms und Kursen – ohne Zusatzkosten. 3+2 Hybrid Work: Du kannst flexibel wählen, ob du im Office oder im Home Office arbeitest – bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche remote, drei Tage im Büro. Top Lage: Unser Office liegt direkt am Rosenthaler Platz – zentral, gut erreichbar, mitten in Berlin. Moderne Ausstattung: Du erhältst ein MacBook und im Office hast du ebenfalls deinen eigenen Platz inkl. Bildschirm. Karriere-Entwicklung: Wir wachsen schnell – und suchen Menschen, die mit uns Experten- oder Führungsverantwortung übernehmen wollen. Team Abende: Wir veranstalten regelmäßig Team Abende, die Spaß machen und das Team zusammenbringen. Bereit mit uns die deutsche B2B-Software Branche zu entwickeln? Sneak Peek: So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab: 1. Erster kurzer Austusch Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns direkt am nächsten Tag bei dir zurück. Im ersten Schritt vereinbaren wir mit dir ein 10-minütiges Telefongespräch mit jemanden aus unserem Team. Hier schauen wir, ob es von beiden Seiten aus passt und finden dann direkt schon einen Folgetermin für den Kick-Off Call. 2. Kick-Off Call Im zweiten Gespräch nehmen wir uns ca. 30 - 45min. Zeit. Wir möchten dich richtig kennenlernen, wissen, was dich fasziniert und dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig bieten wir dir auch einen tieferen Blick hinter die Kulissen von Arvana und beantworten dir alle deine Fragen. Nach dem Gespräch kannst du mal alles reflektieren, sodass wir uns am nächsten Tag nochmal kurz austauschen können. 3. Team Meeting Im letzten Gespräch möchten wir dich gerne in unser Office am Rosenthaler Platz einladen. Du lernst die Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und hast auch die Möglichkeit mit dem Team zu quatschen. In ca. 90 Minuten nehmen wir dich tief mit in unsere Prozesse, Mission, den Business-Plan und geben dir einen 360 Grad Einblick. Nach dem Gespräch melden wir uns innerhalb von 2 Tagen bei dir zurück. Wenn alles passt, freuen wir uns, dich im Team zu begrüßen! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior SRE – OpenStack & Bare Metal (m/f/d)
description: At our company, it’s all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH. As a leading tech company, we’ve been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign. Our Tech Stack 🚀 · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling Your Role You will help us build, operate and industrialize OVHcloud's on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, senior team, you will work on our OpenStack-based infrastructure and the Kubernetes / GitOps stack powering our customer-facing cloud. AI-assisted engineering is a first-class part of how we work – from spec-driven development and agentic coding workflows to incident response and automation. The platform is in active development, giving you real influence on the architecture, automation strategy and how we adopt AI in platform engineering. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and shape your focus based on your strengths, with a clear backbone of automation, compute lifecycle, platform engineering and AI substrate work. Your Responsibilities Design and build our OpenStack-based on-premise cloud infrastructure , with the goal of bringing complete cloud environments from bare metal to production through a highly automated deployment process. Develop and operate Infrastructure as Code with Ansible and Terraform as well as our Kubernetes and GitOps workflows using FluxCD / ArgoCD , supported by LLMs, agentic workflows and automated testing and review. Own the lifecycle of our compute infrastructure – from bare metal, firmware and provisioning through to hypervisors and virtual compute nodes. This includes patching, migrations, host evacuation, capacity rebalancing and the automation required to keep the platform healthy. Build and extend our AI substrate and self-healing capabilities , from structured knowledge bases and agentic workflows for incident triage and capacity planning to gradually turning today's manual runbooks into automated processes. Design tests for non-regression, performance and security, document and package solutions, and continuously improve the platform based on telemetry, operational experience and user feedback. Act as a technical reference and sparring partner for peers across automation, platform engineering and AI tooling. What we offer you A platform genuinely in build mode , with real room to shape architectural decisions, strong ownership and a senior team where autonomy matters. AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including Claude Code and comparable agentic tooling, Markdown-based knowledge bases and room to push our engineering practices further. Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam . Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies. 32 vacation days , increasing with length of service. Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation. Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package. OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs . Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities , such as gym memberships or sports classes. Through Corporate Benefits , you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies. We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike . Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages. Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Platform Engineer or DevOps Engineer running production infrastructure, with strong experience in OpenStack, Kubernetes and Linux , including bare metal. You have managed compute infrastructure end-to-end , from firmware / BIOS rollouts, bare-metal provisioning and hardware diagnostics to hypervisors, migrations, host evacuation, graceful drains and capacity rebalancing. AI-assisted engineering is already part of your daily work. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they meaningfully support development, testing, reviews, or operations, and you know where AI adds real value and where strong engineering expertise remains essential. You are confident working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps workflows such as FluxCD or ArgoCD and understand what it takes to turn automation into robust, repeatable production systems. Ideally, you write Go and/or Python and have experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Aider or comparable agentic coding environments. Exposure to observability, networking, compute tuning, auto-remediation, security-critical infrastructure or multi-site clouds is also a plus. You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership and enjoy improving systems rather than simply keeping them running. You also enjoy sharing knowledge and can communicate complex technical topics clearly. You are fluent in English, written and spoken . English is the working language of our distributed team. At Sungrow, you will help modernize enterprise infrastructure in a fast-moving greentech environment, while building practical solutions across data centers, networks, cloud platforms, and workplace technology. Du entwickelst unser Partnernetzwerk datengetrieben weiter und steuerst es entlang von Kapazitätsbedarfen, regionaler Abdeckung, Auslastung sowie der Segmentierung und Entwicklung einzelner Partner. Du entwickelst die relevanten KPIs und Steuerungsmechanismen , um Performance, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit unseres Partnernetzwerks transparent zu machen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du führst und entwickelst unser Partnerships-Team , setzt klare Ziele und schaffst die Strukturen, mit denen das Team und unser Partnernetzwerk gemeinsam mit 42watt skalieren . Dein Profil Erfahrung im Partner-/Account-Management: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Partner- oder Account-Management mit (operativer oder Einkaufs-Schwerpunkt), idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld. Kommerzielles Denken: Du verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge hinter einem Partnernetzwerk und steuerst konsequent entlang von Umsatz, Marge, Kapazität und Auslastung. Strategische Netzwerksteuerung: Du kannst ein wachsendes Partnernetzwerk strukturiert weiterentwickeln, Kapazitätsbedarfe frühzeitig erkennen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für Akquise, Entwicklung und Steuerung von Partnern ableiten. Führungserfahrung: Du bringst Führungserfahrung in der Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Teams mit und schaffst klare Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Strukturen. Ownership & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du denkst strategisch, setzt aber genauso gerne selbst um – vom wichtigen Partnergespräch und der Verhandlung bis zur Verbesserung eines operativen Prozesses. Scale-up-Mindset: Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem sich Strukturen schnell verändern, nicht jeder Prozess bereits definiert ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist. Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern – vom Handwerksbetrieb über Großhandel und OEMs bis hin zu internen Führungskräften. Sonstiges: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools und CRM-Systemen. Company Bike: Lease dein Wunschrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen und nutze es auch privat. Rundum-Schutz ist inklusive. Optional kannst du auch ein zweites Bike für deine:n Partner:in leasen. 50 € monatlich on top: Du erhältst jeden Monat einen steuerfreien Benefit von 50 € bei mindestens 30 Std./Woche bzw. 25 € bei weniger als 30 Std./Woche. Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine, Getränke und frisches Obst stehen ebenfalls für dich bereit. Zeit fürs Team: Zweiwöchentliches Breakfast, Afterwork Drinks, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier. Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery. Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring. A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside. title: Senior UX Researcher/ Designer
description: <p></p> <h3><strong>🚀 About the role</strong></h3> <p><strong>Career track:</strong> IC4</p> <p><strong>Unit:</strong> LX</p> <p>As Senior UX Researcher / Designer, you will play a vital role in understanding our learner audience. This role sits within our Learner Experience (LX) division, a fully-funded zero to one startup within our established business.</p> <p>You will guide rich, foundational research that shapes what we build before design work begins. Bringing genuine research depth and being comfortable with exploring ambiguous, early-stage problems, you will also be hands-on enough in design to turn what you learn directly into work that ships.</p> <p><strong>You will be responsible for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Foundational Generative Research: </strong>Heading up exploratory research to build a deep, evidence-based understanding of learners, their needs, behaviours, and unmet problems in ambiguous, early-stage problem spaces, setting up continuous discovery practices.</li> <li><strong>Methodological Rigour & Infrastructure: </strong>Applying structured research methodology, study design, sampling strategies, and bias mitigation, whilst building a robust research repository and knowledge base to compound insight over time.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Insight Sharing: </strong>Sharing generative insights clearly with Product Management, UX Design, and Growth Marketing to shape decisions, product directions, and commercial conversations and positioning.</li> <li><strong>Design Delivery: </strong>As a small, start-up style team, dedicating roughly 30% of your capacity to translating research insights directly into simple, elegant, production-ready, and highly accessible user experience design solutions.</li> <li><strong>Team Collaboration & Growth: </strong>Working closely with the Lead UX Designer to manage and balance capacity, mentoring colleagues to raise research maturity across the Learning Experience team.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>👥 Meet the team</strong></h3> <p>You'll report directly into our Chief Product Officer (CPO). On a day-to-day basis, you will work hand-in-hand with the Lead UX Designer to coordinate design and research capacity across our squads. You’ll also collaborate closely with both of our Learning Experience Product Managers, Technical Leads, the Growth Marketing Lead, and the wider Learning Experience division.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>👤About you:</strong></h3> <p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Generative Research Expertise: </strong>Strong skills in foundational research methods, interview design, diary studies, sacrificial concepts, prototyping, Jobs-to-be-Done frameworks, and segmentation research.</li> <li><strong>Methodological Rigour: </strong>Proven ability to apply structured study design, sampling strategy, and bias mitigation with real methodical precision, and synthesis frameworks that transform messy findings into actionable insights.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on Design Delivery: </strong>Comfort dedicating ~30% of your time to executing high-quality, elegant, and shippable design solutions utilizing design systems.</li> <li><strong>Accessibility Standards: </strong>Experienced in designing and researching inclusively to meet WCAG standards for diverse access requirements.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration & Mentorship: </strong>Passionate about sharing knowledge, mentoring peers to raise research maturity, and providing direct, empathetic feedback.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice to have: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>AI-Driven Experiences: </strong>Familiarity researching and designing for AI-mediated interactions, including balancing AI visibility, user control, and trust-building.</li> <li><strong>AI Tool Integration: </strong>Intentional and effective use of AI tools in your own practice for synthesis, prototyping, or exploring directions faster.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>💰Salary and benefits:</strong></h3> <p>💸£69,000 - £81,000 dependent upon experience</p> <p>🏖️ 33 days annual leave (Inclusive of bank holidays)</p> <p>🎄 3 gifted days off at Christmas</p> <p>💰 EMI Share Options Scheme</p> <p>🎓 Generous individual learning and training allowance</p> <p>⌚ Truly flexible hours to suit when you work best</p> <p>💻 Full home working set up and beautiful collaborative office space</p> <p>🚗 Free Leeds City Centre office parking</p> <p>🌴 Nomad working policy with family travel insurance</p> <p>🍼 Enhanced 26 weeks maternity and 4 weeks paternity (fully paid)</p> <p>🤍 Health cash plan (from glasses to massages)</p> <p>💸 6% employer pension contribution</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>📍Location: </strong></h3> <p>Our beautiful office space in Leeds is our key hub for collaboration, and we love to get together in person. We operate a flexible hybrid working model, including supporting our Genios who are based remotely across the UK. If you are more than 50 miles away from the office, we offer full remote working support, with the opportunity to join colleagues for in-person collaboration several times a year.</p> <p>We will discuss ways of working with you at interview however if you have any questions before you apply please reach out to <a ---------- <p> </p> <p></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Engineer - Human-Centric Technologies (Defence & Security)
description: <h3>The Role  </h3> <p>We have an opportunity for a Principal Engineer working with a particular focus on our defence and security clients. You’ll join a team of talented engineers and scientists designing, building, and testing intelligent, human-centric systems.  </p> <p>As one of the senior technical voices in the team, you’ll be architecting the technical approach on our projects, setting the technical bar for others, and helping shape the work we deliver. As well as hands-on research and engineering, you’ll spend time with clients, using your expertise to win new projects as well as deliver them.  </p> <p>Much of our defence and security work requires security clearance, so we ask for it up front. You won’t work exclusively in that sector, but a genuine interest in it matters to us.  </p> <p>We offer a flexible approach to hybrid working, although some of the projects you will be working on will require full-time working in the office.  </p> <p> </p> <h3>What you’ll be doing  </h3> <ul> <li>Designing and developing human-centric intelligent systems: technical frameworks and architectures that perceive, reason about, and adapt to human state, behaviour, and intent in real time using multi-modal sensing and contextual modelling.   </li> <li>Designing, protocolling, and running human subject studies, conducting empirical data evaluation, and synthesising scientific insights to inform and back technology design.   </li> <li>Conducting deep literature reviews across experimental psychology, cognitive science, and human factors, translating complex concepts into actionable engineering requirements.   </li> <li>Acting as technical lead and architect on our larger, more complex projects, owning the technical solution and the value it delivers to the client.   </li> <li>Develop proposals and costed work programmes, turning client problems into work we can win and deliver.   </li> <li>Setting technical direction and acting as technical reviewer across the department, with your advice sought by colleagues.   </li> <li>Steering internal capability, research, and demonstrators that keep us at the forefront of technology and open up new conversations with clients.   </li> <li>Mentoring engineers and scientists and conducting technical interviews to help us recruit and grow strong people.   </li> <li>Supporting and contributing to how the department works, improving our processes and technical standards.  </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>What you can bring </h3> title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)
description: <h2>About us</h2> <p>At Cambridge Consultants, we believe the future of technology isn't just smart, it has agency. We're moving past passive tools and building human-centred digital services and products: systems that reason, plan, and act around the people who use them. Our work spans autonomous systems at the frontier of biology, sensing, and AI.</p> <p>We hire self-motivated builders, not ticket-takers. If you thrive in highly agile environments, can cut through ambiguity with first-principles thinking, and want to ship things that matter, this is the kind of place where you'll feel at home.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>You'll be working on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling problems no one else can solve.</p> <p>Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.</p> <p>You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.</p> <p>There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).</p> <p>Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.</p> <h2>What we ask of you</h2> <p>The examples below describe the core domains our AI Engineers own within the Digital Services team. We don't expect every candidate to have mastered all of these, but if you can demonstrate a strong combination of the following, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>AI System Architecture:</strong> Designing and implementing the logic for autonomous systems, including maintaining world models, integrating multimodal sensing, and building real-time human-machine interaction loops.</p> <p><strong>Infrastructure & Production Engineering:</strong> Designing the underlying software for scalable, secure, and observable cloud deployments. You will apply the engineering rigor required to take experimental AI from concept to robust live launch.</p> <p><strong>Rapid Client Prototyping:</strong> Driving a demo-first delivery model. You will focus on fast experimentation to actively show tangible value and working software to clients, rather than describing it in slide decks.</p> <p><strong>Domain Translation & Integration:</strong> Partnering directly with deep-tech subject matter experts (like biologists and roboticists) to apply software solutions to complex physical constraints.</p> <h2>Indicators you'll be a good fit</h2> <p><strong>Applied AI Expertise:</strong> You have hands-on experience utilising multi-agent frameworks, long-term memory systems, RAG pipelines, vector/graph databases, and reasoning-loop patterns (such as ReAct and Chain-of-Thought).</p> <p><strong>Core Software Fluency:</strong> You possess strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, coupled with practical experience in cloud engineering, containerisation, and modern DevOps. You know that great agents still require rock-solid software foundations.</p> <p><strong>High Tolerance for Ambiguity:</strong> You are energised by uncertainty and shifting targets. You treat changing requirements as a normal part of frontier work, and you know exactly when to ship a rough prototype to learn quickly versus when to slow down for architectural rigour.</p> <p><strong>Cross-Disciplinary Communication:</strong> You can seamlessly navigate the gap between code and reality, collaborating with clients, roboticists, and scientists to clearly deliver the "art of the possible."</p> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p><strong>Variety of work: </strong>Projects spanning biotech, finance, robotics, and beyond. No two engagements look alike.</p> <p><strong>Continuous learning: </strong>A mentoring and learning package shaped by your goals, backed by squad-based knowledge sharing across the company.</p> <p><strong>Engineering autonomy: </strong>A free hand in choosing the right tools and processes. We trust your engineering judgement.</p> <p><strong>Access to world-class experts: </strong>You'll share a building with biologists, roboticists, electronics engineers, and mathematicians. Few places let you tap that range of expertise on a single project.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid working environment:</strong> We're flexible about where you work on a day-to-day basis. title: ML Engineer (Research Scientist - Cryosphere)
description: LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK FULL-TIME, HYBRID: 2 DAYS (MIN) ON-SITE, 3 DAYS REMOTE THE LAST FRONTIER Arctic Research and Development (ARD) was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE ARD is building Auka - an intelligence layer for the Arctic that turns a flood of observations into understanding, foresight, and action. Our approach is deliberately grounded in modern science. We develop and run physics models, collect empirical data in the field and laboratory and then use that knowledge to extract meaning from our diverse datasets. We avoid black boxes — the products we ship trace back to the physics and data that produced it. This role focuses on developing and tuning machine learning pipelines that are fast, trustworthy, and traceable, ingesting diverse datasets with an emphasis on remotely sensed imagery. These pipelines will form the foundational products on which our longer-term Arctic intelligence platform will build. You will own the Analyse-and-ML workstream, working directly with the Science Lead, set the technical direction for how physics and ML meet at ARD, and become a pivotal founding member of the ARD science team. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Distil reference physics into fast operators - build emulators / surrogates that run orders of magnitude faster than our reference physics models. Own the forward-to-inverse bridge - Build the ML that inverts real hyperspectral and multispectral imagery into physical quantities (albedo, melt state, impurity loading), with the physics as the constraint, not an afterthought. Make trust a property of the model, not a report - bake in uncertainty quantification, provenance, and validation against cold-lab and field measurements. Outputs must be defensible pixel-to-decision. Set the technical bar for physics ⇄ ML across the science team, and help shape and mentor the hires that follow you. Ship into the platform - work with the Science Lead and Head of Software so your models land in production — not just in papers. REQUIREMENTS We are looking for a scientist who lives on the seam between physical modelling and machine learning — someone whose instinct is to respect and accelerate physics, not replace it with an opaque network. Essential A PhD (or equivalent research track record) in a physical, geophysical, computational, or ML discipline, with a body of work at the physics–ML interface: physics-informed / hybrid models, emulators or surrogate models, neural operators, differentiable simulation, or data assimilation with learned components. Working knowledge of the cryosphere (specifically sea-ice physics). We will weight the ability to reason fluently about physical models over any specific sub-domain, and we also highly value marine and atmospheric science — but you should be able to engage with radiative-transfer and ice-surface physics without hand-holding. Fluency with uncertainty quantification and with validating models against real measurements. GIS or geospatial data handling Machine learning or data science background Strong scientific software engineering: production-quality Python, reproducibility, version control, testing. Your models are meant to ship. Seniority to own a workstream and be delegated to — able to set direction, make sound calls under ambiguity independently, and represent the science externally. Strongly preferred Experience with Earth-observation / remote-sensing retrieval — inverting satellite or drone imagery into physical quantities, atmospheric correction, cal/val. The cloud-native geospatial stack (Xarray, Zarr, Dask, STAC; the Pangeo ecosystem). WHAT WE VALUE You reach for the simplest model that respects the physics before the biggest one. You treat provenance and uncertainty as first-class, not documentation added at the end. You've shipped something real that others depend on — an open-source tool, an operational model, a product. Why ARD The mission - The Arctic is the fastest-changing region on Earth. title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description: SENIOR FIRMWARE ENGINEER FULL-TIME | ENGINEERING LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK - ONSITE, WITH FIELD TRAVEL THE LAST FRONTIER The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure. Arctic Research and Development (ARD) was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Senior Firmware Engineer to join our small team to help develop high-reliability firmware for deployment into some of the most challenging places on earth. You will be writing firmware for embedded processors (ARM M4, M33 etc) interfacing with sensors and other products via SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, LoRA, UART and much more. You will have a real impact being responsible for firmware architecture, coding, testing and debugging across the ARD products. We want you to use your knowledge and experience to make key decisions and challenge other team members to make high quality products suitable for use in the Arctic. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Design & Development — Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for microcontrollers and microprocessors, writing efficient, reliable, and well-documented code primarily in C/C++ or assembly language. Hardware Integration — Collaborate closely with hardware engineering teams to integrate firmware with electronic components, including sensors, communication interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN), and peripheral devices. Testing & Debugging — Perform unit testing, integration testing, and system-level validation of firmware, using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG debuggers, and emulators to diagnose and resolve issues. RTOS & Boot Systems — Develop and optimize real-time operating system (RTOS) configurations, bootloaders, and interrupt-driven systems to meet strict timing and performance requirements. Code Quality & Version Control — Maintain high standards of code quality through peer reviews, adherence to coding standards, and use of version control systems (e.g., Git) to manage firmware releases and revisions. Cross-functional Collaboration — Work alongside software, mechanical, and QA teams throughout the product development lifecycle, contributing to technical documentation, design reviews, and supporting regulatory or compliance testing as needed. WHAT WE VALUE 5+ years of embedded firmware development experience in C for ARM or equivalent processors. Priori experience with the STM32 family of processors is desirable. Proven track record developing and delivering firmware from creating requirements, architecture design, implementation through to release including use of Git Experience working with SPI, I2C, UART protocols is essential Experience with RTOS and bare-metal design, in particular using FreeRTOS and Zephyr Understanding of bootloaders and OTA for updating multi-processor products Experience debugging on real hardware and confidence using basic equipment such as logic analysers and oscilloscopes TCP/IP and networking experience is a bonus but not essential Degree in a related engineering discipline such as firmware, software or electronics is a plus however not essential. Experience is highly valued! Willingness to test in the field to prove functionality and compliance Self-driven attitude and confidence working in a startup where you will be the subject matter expert. NICE TO HAVE Understanding of electronics design such as how to read a schematic and soldering.
