Du übersetzt Hooks, Angles und Offers in Layouts, die im Feed sofort funktionieren: klare Hierarchie, auf dem Handy lesbar, Produkt im Fokus. Du baust schnell und sauber Iterationen von Winner-Ads: neue Hooks, Formate, Visuals, Farbwelten. Du arbeitest innerhalb der Brand Guidelines und weißt, wann du sie im Sinne der Performance dehnen kannst. Du arbeitest eng mit Motion und Video zusammen und lieferst Dateien, die direkt animiert werden können. Du setzt KI-Tools (z. B. Firefly, Generative Fill, Midjourney) gezielt für Compositing, Freisteller und Szenen ein, ohne dass das Ergebnis nach KI aussieht. Du organisierst deine Projekte selbstständig und lieferst zuverlässig pünktlich. Dein Profil Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Grafikdesigner, davon nachweislich mit Social Ads oder Performance Creatives (Agentur oder In-house bei einer E-Commerce Brand). Sicher in Photoshop, Illustrator und Figma. Ein starkes Portfolio mit echten, live geschalteten Ads. Reine Branding-, Print- oder Uni-Projekte reichen für diese Rolle nicht. Sehr gutes Gespür für Typografie, Layout, Farbe und Bildbearbeitung (Retusche, Compositing, Freisteller). Du kennst die Ad-Formate (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) und Safe Zones und weißt, wie ein Static im Feed wirken muss. Du weißt, was CTR, Hook Rate und ROAS bedeuten, und willst verstehen, warum ein Creative gewinnt. Du arbeitest schnell und bleibst trotzdem pixelgenau, auch bei der 20. Variante. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (in Wort und Schrift). Lebensmittelpunkt München (unverzichtbar). Wir setzen auf Office-First. Diese Rolle ist NICHT für dich, wenn: Du um Punkt 18:00 Uhr den Laptop zuklappst. Du Ads für die kleine Schwester von „echtem“ Design hältst. Du an deinem Design festhältst, obwohl die Zahlen etwas anderes sagen. Du für jede Variante erst eine Woche Inspiration brauchst. Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn: Du Ads im Feed nicht wegscrollst, sondern screenshottest und zerlegst. Du Bock hast, dass deine Arbeit an echten Zahlen gemessen wird. Du schnell iterierst und aus jedem Test etwas mitnimmst. Du den Ehrgeiz hast, zu den Besten in deinem Fach zu gehören. Du mit einem preisgekrönten Design & Motion Team wachsen möchtest. Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit E-Commerce Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle, Supplements). Grundkenntnisse in After Effects, um Statics leicht zu animieren. Erfahrung mit Creative Strategy, Ad-Library-Research oder Creative Testing. Erfahrung mit Landingpage- oder Shopify-Design. Warum wir? Ein starkes Grafik-Team, das eng mit Motion, Video und Performance zusammenarbeitet. Du siehst, was deine Creatives bewirken. Echte Zahlen statt Bauchgefühl. Motiviertes High-Performance-Team: keine Politik, flache Hierarchien, getragen von deiner Eigeninitiative. Spannende Leadgen- und E-Commerce-Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle). Fettes und steuerfreies Benefitpaket inkl. Sachbezug, Wellpass, Mittagessen, Deutschlandticket. Modernes, zentrales Office im Herzen Münchens (Gärtnerplatz), der Ankerpunkt unserer Zusammenarbeit und Kultur. Team-Events, Workshops, Weiterbildungen. Darauf schauen wir Schick uns ein kurzes Anschreiben, so knapp wie möglich. Drei klare Benefits, warum es sich lohnt, mit dir zu arbeiten, reichen völlig. Dazu dein Portfolio mit mindestens 5 Ads, die wirklich live waren. Deine Challenge: Wir erwarten, dass du unsere Ausschreibung bis ins Detail liest. Die Bewerbung ist deshalb schon ein kleiner Test. Füge das Bild einer Zitrone in dein Anschreiben, deinen Lebenslauf oder deine Bewerbungsmail ein. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong>Site Reliability Engineer</strong></p> <p>As a part of Sony Computer Entertainment, the <span data-contrast="none">Gaming,<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><span class="searchHighlight">Developer</span><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>& Future<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><span class="searchHighlight">Technology Group</span> (<span data-teams="true">GDFT</span>)</span> is leading the cloud gaming revolution, putting console-quality video games on any device, from TVs to consoles to mobile devices and beyond.</p> <p>Our Site Reliability Engineering team plays a significant role in delivering on the promise of a great cloud gaming experience to our customers. We do this by influencing design and operational decisions towards the overall stability of the gaming service. Our SREs focus on three main things: overall ownership of production, production code quality, and deployments. The successful candidate will be self-directed and able to participate in the way we make decisions at different levels.</p> <p>We expect our SREs to have opinions on the state of our service and provide critical feedback during different phases of the operational lifecycle. We are engaged throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring the operational readiness and stability.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead team technical discussions, especially around ongoing improvements in Reliability and Scalability</li> <li>Be involved in creating High Level Designs (HLDs) for new products and platforms</li> <li>Mentor junior SRE staff and enable them for success</li> <li>Lead incident response and post-mortem activities within your assigned service team</li> <li>Work with other Engineers in a cross-functional team to prioritise reliability improvements to address technical debt and toil</li> <li>Contribute to code to improve reliability</li> <li>Implement automation to reduce ongoing toil</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 5+ years working experience in Software Development and/or Linux Systems Administration role.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Available to be scheduled in on-call rotation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Knowledge:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proficient as a Linux Production Systems Engineer, with experience managing large scale Web Services infrastructure.</li> <li>Development experience in one or more of the following programming languages:</li> <li>Python (preferred)</li> <li>Bash, Go, Java, C++, or Rust</li> <li>In addition, experience with at least 3 of the following topics:</li> <li>Distributed data storage at scale (Hadoop, Ceph)</li> <li>NoSQL at scale (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra)</li> <li>Data Aggregation technologies. (ElasticSearch, Kafka)</li> <li>Scaling and running traditional RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL) with High Availability</li> <li>Monitoring & Alerting (Prometheus, Grafana), and Incident Management toolsets</li> <li>Kubernetes and/or AWS (deployment and management)</li> <li>Software Distribution (Package management and distribution at scale)</li> <li>Configuration Management (ansible, saltstack, puppet, chef)</li> <li>S/W Performance analysis and load testing (QA or SDET experience: a plus)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p class="p1">Please refer to our <a href="https://www.playstation.com/legal/careers-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p><em>Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.</em></p> <p><em>We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond. </em></p> <p><em>Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent Rezeptmanagement (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>Deine Rolle</strong></h2> <p>Als Werkstudent/in im Rezeptmanagement unterstützt du unser Rezeptentwicklungsteam bei der Pflege und Verwaltung kulinarischer Daten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Culinary-Operations-Team zusammen und sorgst mit einem guten Blick fürs Detail, Struktur und Sorgfalt dafür, dass Rezepturen korrekt abgebildet und unsere Datensätze zuverlässig gepflegt sind.</p> <p>Bitte beachte, dass diese Stelle zunächst auf 12 Monate befristet ist.</p> <h2><strong>Dein Verantwortungsbereich</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Rezept-Management: </strong>Pflege und Aktualisierung von Rezeptdaten in unseren internen Systemen sowie kurzfristige Anpassung von Rezepten bei Änderungen von Zutaten</li> <li><strong>Korrekturlesen:</strong> Prüfung von Rezepten auf korrekte Datenpunkte, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz</li> <li><strong>Rezept-Optimierung:</strong> Erstellung und Überprüfung anpassbarer Rezeptvarianten auf Basis bestehender Rezepte</li> <li><strong>Datenkontrolle:</strong> Regelmäßige Validierung der Einträge in unserem System sowie systematische Fehleranalyse und -behebung</li> <li><strong>Performance-Analyse: </strong>Unterstützung bei der Auswertung von Rezepten auf Basis von Kundenfeedback sowie Zusammenfassung neuer Erkenntnisse und wiederkehrender Muster</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Dein Profil </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Studium mit Bezug zu Ernährung, Daten, Naturwissenschaften oder Wirtschaft</li> <li>Begeisterung für die Themen Essen und Kochen sowie grundlegendes kulinarisches Verständnis (z. B. Garzeiten, Geschmacksprofile, Zutatenkunde), welches eine fachliche Beurteilung bzw. Bearbeitung von Rezepten ermöglicht - auch ohne selbst am Herd zu stehen</li> <li>Detailverliebtheit, Zuverlässigkeit und ein selbstständiger Arbeitsstil, kombiniert mit Freude an klaren Strukturen und sorgfältiger Datenpflege</li> <li>Lösungsorientiertes Denken und die Fähigkeit, logisch nachvollziehbare Alternativen selbstständig zu entwickeln</li> <li>Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mind. auf C1-Niveau)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bieten wir Dir</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Einen Wohlfühlarbeitsplatz </strong>mit einem tollen Team in Berlin-Kreuzberg</li> <li><strong>Rabatte</strong> auf unsere HelloFresh Kochboxen und Convini-Produkte</li> <li><strong>Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten</strong> durch interne Trainings sowie ein jährliches Team-Budget für Weiterbildung <strong> (NICHT FÜR PRAKTIKANTEN)</strong></li> <li><strong>Ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld</strong> mit Vertrauensarbeitszeit & Work From Home/Work From Abroad Policy </li> <li><strong>Ein umfassendes Onboarding</strong> inkl. Buddy-Programm</li> <li><strong>Spaß</strong> bei Teamevents, Friday Beers, Company Runs, Buchclub u.v.m.</li> <li><strong>Vergünstigte Fitnessangebote</strong> bei Urban Sports Club bzw. John Reed, regelmäßige Yoga-Sessions</li> <li><strong>Initiativen für das Wohlbefinden</strong> durch Kooperationen mit der Headspace-App und Spill</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Einen monatlichen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket</strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Bist du die fehlende Zutat?</strong></h2> <p class="p1">Wenn diese Gelegenheit für Dich lecker klingt, freuen wir uns darauf, von Dir zu hören. Wir bemühen uns, Dein Profil zu prüfen und Dir innerhalb von 5 Werktagen zu antworten.</p> <p class="p1"> </p> <p><br><span style="color: rgb(206, 212, 217);">#JD1002</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Supply Chain Planning Working Student (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>Your role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Supply Chain planning working student for 12 months at the heart of our Product team, where you will be responsible for supporting our operational and strategic needs for our physical product: meal kits. You will be central to our activity and will have a significant influence on our customers' meals.</p> <p>We are looking for someone capable of assisting us in the operational planning of recipes at HelloFresh. This is a unique opportunity to learn and gain experience within a fast-growing company that is pioneering the food industry.</p> <p>If you want to be a driving force in the growth of a scale-up, then this position is for you!</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Your area of responsibility</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Menu creation and optimization: </strong>Assist the team in creating and optimizing menus using our python-based menu-planning algorithm.</li> <li><strong>Product Improvement:</strong> You will work on several projects and initiatives that focus on improving our product offering aiming to increase customer satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>Menu De-Risking:</strong> You will lead a number of cross-collaborative initiatives and processes aiming to reduce the menu risk and to ensure ingredient availability by considering the end-to-end value chain of our product. </li> <li><strong>Operations support:</strong> You support the team in day-to-day operations as well as with administrative and organizational tasks along the supply and menu planning process and have the opportunity to solve concrete problems, make decisions, and learn to manage real-world situations in a dynamic environment.</li> <li><strong>Process management:</strong> You will participate in projects aimed at optimizing and automating and improving our product processes and supply chain by working title: Founding Data Engineer
description: TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically. You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself. What you will be working on Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable. Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data. Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage. Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining. Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture. Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time. What We Are Looking For You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you. Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself. Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation. Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture. Nice to have Computer vision and document understanding , images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD. Graph and structured scientific data , molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data. Synthetic worlds and simulation , a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap. Foundation models from scratch , real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning. Public evidence of data ownership , lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data. GIS and geometry , parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization. Multi-country data , heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules. Why Join Davis Own the data end to end , from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from. Shape a foundation model from scratch , on a structured representation no one else is training on. Work on genuinely hard problems , image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days. Competitive salary and meaningful equity , at a founding level, in an early-stage company. Join a world-class team , a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs. More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after: Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we are a team of twelve : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need. Why We Will Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work , AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability , and parametric tools only check constraints after generation , which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites. Generative AI has the potential to solve this , but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable. This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application. title: Senior Product Designer
description: About us Join bonify, Germany’s leading platform for credit scoring and financial management. We are on the mission to revolutionize the FinTech industry and make the credit score and financial data available and transparent for our users. We are hiring a Senior Product Designer to shape how millions of users understand and improve their financial health across mobile and web. You'll own design end-to-end for a defined product area, from framing the right problems through research, prototyping, validation, and delivery. Our focus is on creating more value beyond the credit score, making complex financial information feel simple, useful, and trustworthy, and embedding AI into both our products and our daily work. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a strong research mindset. You'll speak directly with German-speaking users, work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data, contribute to our design system, and support less experienced designers through collaboration and feedback. Your tasks Lead product design for a defined area across mobile and web. Turn complex financial and credit-related information into experiences that feel simple, useful and trustworthy. Plan and conduct customer research, interviews and usability testing, particularly with German-speaking users. Translate qualitative research and behavioural data into clear product decisions. Create user flows, interaction models, prototypes and polished product experiences in Figma. Work closely with Engineering to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable and implemented with high quality. Partner with Product and Data to define what success looks like and evaluate the impact of shipped work. Contribute to and improve reusable patterns and our design system. Use AI practically in your day-to-day work to accelerate research, exploration, prototyping and documentation. Help shape AI-powered customer experiences where relevant — while applying strong judgement around trust, clarity and user control. Share your expertise, give thoughtful feedback and help raise the quality of design across the team. Requirements You have around 6–8 years of experience in product design, ideally working on digital consumer products. Strong experience designing end-to-end product experiences across mobile and web. Advanced skills in Figma, interaction design and prototyping. Strong hands-on user research experience — not only consuming research, but planning and conducting it yourself. The ability to simplify complex, data-heavy or sensitive topics into clear customer experiences. Strong product thinking and the ability to connect design decisions to customer and business outcomes. Experience working closely with Product, Engineering and Data in cross-functional teams. Confidence working independently and taking ownership from ambiguity through delivery. German at C1 level or above, including the ability to conduct customer interviews and usability studies. Strong practical experience using AI tools in your design workflow — for example in exploration, synthesis, prototyping or documentation. A collaborative, kind and constructive working style. Experience in fintech, banking, financial services or another regulated/data-intensive environment is a strong plus. What we offer As part of the bonify team, you'll have: The opportunity to take ownership from day one The chance to thrive in a dynamic and flexible startup environment. Access to extensive coaching and training programs through our personal development budget 30 vacation days Subsidies for BVG and UrbanSportsClub 1:1 language classes in both German and English. The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavourable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy, and maternity. Please note, to be compliant with AML Offices, due to the specifics of fintech industries additional background checks are required (applicable only at the offer stage). If you're ready to make a meaningful impact in the world of FinTech and embark on an exciting career journey, apply now to join bonify! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Director Data Strategy (Mensch)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Das bieten wir dir:</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Work-Life-Balance</strong>: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.</li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on</strong>: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first: </strong>Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p> </p> <h2>Das bewegst du:</h2> <p>Als <strong>Director Data Strategy Consulting (Mensch)</strong> bist du das strategische Rückgrat, das Gesicht und das unternehmerische Bindeglied unserer Data-Strategy-Unit. Du verantwortest die End-to-End-Datenstrategie für unsere Fokus-Kunden – von der strategischen Gestaltung über die Steuerung von Technologie-Roadmaps bis zur kommerziellen Weiterentwicklung – und leitest, inspirierst und entwickelst dabei ein hochqualifiziertes Team von Data Strategists.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Teamführung:</strong> Du leitest, inspirierst und entwickelst ein hochqualifiziertes Team von Data Strategists und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem dein Team über sich hinauswachsen kann.</li> <li><strong>Strategische Datenanwendung & Kundenentwicklung:</strong> Du verantwortest die End-to-End-Datenstrategie für unsere Fokus-Kunden und agierst als strategisches Rückgrat unserer Data-Strategy-Unit. Durch die Priorisierung von First-Party-Data-Kollaborationen, Private Data Networks und KI-gestützter Planung entwickelst du audience-first-Strategien über 1PD-, 2PD- und 3PD-Daten hinweg und übersetzt Datenpotenziale in messbare Business-Erfolge – von Wachstum über Effizienz bis hin zu Effektivität.</li> <li><strong>Daten- & Technologie-Roadmap:</strong> Du gestaltest den Einsatz moderner Werbetechnologien wie Data Clean Rooms, CDPs und DSPs und verbindest Kunden-Roadmaps mit Innovationen in den Bereichen KI, Audience-Produkte und Measurement. Dabei triffst du strategische Entscheidungen zu Datenpartnerschaften und Aktivierungspfaden, bindest globale Lösungen wie WPP Open, Open Media Studio, Open Intelligence und InfoSum ein und bringst Marktanforderungen in globale Produkt-Roadmaps ein.</li> <li><strong>Kunden- & Stakeholder-Management:</strong> Als strategische:r Berater:in begleitest du Marketing-, Media-, Daten- und Commerce-Verantwortliche auf Entscheider-Ebene. Geschäftsziele übersetzt du in datengetriebene Strategien und Umsetzungspläne und verknüpfst Datenstrategie mit Media-Ergebnissen und messbarem Business Impact.</li> <li><strong>Enablement & Kompetenzaufbau:</strong> Du entwickelst marktreife Playbooks und etablierst Standards für Audience-Strategien, Governance und Entscheidungsprozesse. In Strategie-Workshops stärkst du datenstrategische Kompetenzen sowie die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden- und Agenturteams.</li> <li><strong>Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit:</strong> Du verantwortest das Kunden-Outcome-Portfolio und steuerst gemeinsam mit Client Analytics & Data Science, Data & Technology Consulting und Product Enablement die erfolgreiche Umsetzung datenstrategischer Lösungen. Dabei überführst du Erkenntnisse in konkrete Entscheidungen und Maßnahmen.</li> <li><strong>Unternehmertum:</strong> Du steuerst das Neugeschäft im Bereich Data Strategy, sicherst die Wirtschaftlichkeit deines Verantwortungsbereichs und entwickelst belastbare Business Cases. Auf Basis nachgewiesener Ergebnisse identifizierst du Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale und treibst nachhaltiges Wachstum voran.</li> <li><strong>Thought Leadership:</strong> Du positionierst WPP Media als Vordenker für moderne Datenstrategie und machst den Business Impact datengetriebener Lösungen durch Executive Briefings, Case Studies und POVs sichtbar.</li> <li><strong>Führungskultur:</strong> Als Vorbild für Inclusive Leadership förderst du Diversität, Eigenverantwortung und eine Kultur der Wertschätzung, Zusammenarbeit und des gemeinsamen Erfolgs.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Das zeichnet dich aus:</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Führungserfahrung:</strong> Nachweisbare, mehrjährige Erfahrung (mind. 2–3 Jahre) in der disziplinarischen und fachlichen Führung sowie in der Entwicklung von Teams.</li> <li><strong>Branchenexpertise:</strong> Mindestens 7 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im datengetriebenen Marketing, der Media-, Beratungs- oder AdTech/MarTech-Branche, mit praktischer Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Datenstrategien.</li> <li><strong>Fachkompetenz:</strong> Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Dateninfrastrukturen, Data Clean Rooms (z. B. InfoSum), CDPs, DSPs, Tagging, Analytics sowie von KI/ML-Konzepten im Marketing – mit der Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu definieren und mit Fachspezialist:innen in die Umsetzung zu bringen.</li> <li><strong>Datenkompetenz:</strong> Sichere praktische Anwendung von 1PD/2PD/3PD-Daten sowie Kunden-, Business- und Marketingdaten in der Datenkollaboration und -aktivierung.</li> <li><strong>Methodenwissen:</strong> Fundiertes Wissen in den Bereichen Measurement, Incrementality-Frameworks sowie im agilen Projekt- und Change-Management; Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrgleisiger Programme mit klaren Routinen und Dokumentation.</li> <li><strong>Unternehmerisches Denken:</strong> Eine klare Vision für deinen Einflussbereich, ein ausgeprägter Gestaltungswille und ein exzellentes Standing bei Kunden und Kollegen.</li> <li><strong>Netzwerkkompetenz:</strong> Als kollaborativer Matrix-Networker suchst du aktiv den Austausch über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg und zeichnest dich durch hohe Problemlösungskompetenz aus.</li> <li><strong>Kommunikationsstärke:</strong> Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen einfach zu erklären und Vertrauen bei Kunden- und Agentur-Counterparts aufzubauen.</li> <li><strong>Ausbildung:</strong> Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor) erforderlich, ein weiterführender Abschluss ist von Vorteil.</li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du:<strong> #teamfähig #lösungsorientiert #kommunikativ</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p></p> <h2>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br> <br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. title: Territory Account Executive, Commercial (Germany)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p> <p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>The <strong>Territory Account Executive</strong> (TAE) is a key growth role within Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) Germany's Go-To-Market organisation. This position focuses on driving growth across all accounts not currently managed by an Account Executive, including the full install base, dormant accounts, and new inbound opportunities. TAEs are responsible for expanding Pure’s footprint, reigniting customer relationships, and capturing new business through a combination of direct engagement and partner collaboration.<br><br>As a Territory Account Executive (TAE), you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing this vision to life - helping customers unlock the power of their data, modernise their infrastructure, and accelerate transformation. You’ll <strong>join our Commercial team in Germany</strong>, with the autonomy to own a dynamic territory, driving growth across a broad set of customers, from re-engaging dormant relationships to winning new logos.</p> <p>At Pure, you’ll join a culture built on curiosity, innovation, and integrity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, challenge convention, and empower our people to think big, take bold action, and make a measurable impact. This is your opportunity to grow your career with one of the most innovative technology companies in the world and to do work that truly changes how businesses use data to compete and win.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Account Growth & Pipeline:</strong> Execute sales activities to generate revenue, manage a high-volume pipeline, and contribute to closing deals on a quarterly basis.</li> <li><strong>Execute Outreach & Prospecting:</strong> Perform consistent, high-activity prospecting to penetrate new accounts, reach decision-makers, and learn how to win new business effectively.</li> <li><strong>Support Partner Strategy:</strong> Collaborate closely with Channel Partners and Partner Managers to align on customer engagement and utilise partner resources to advance opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Reactivate Customer Relationships:</strong> Focus on re-engaging dormant or inactive customers by discovering new business use cases and identifying potential refresh and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Build Foundational Skills:</strong> Develop and deliver proposals and business cases that clearly demonstrate the value of Pure's solutions, supported by internal experts.</li> <li><strong>Maintain Sales Discipline:</strong> Diligently manage sales technology (Salesforce), deliver accurate forecasts, and maintain strong time management to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Sales Experience:</strong> Demonstrated success in direct, full-lifecycle B2B technology sales with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales metrics (KPIs).</li> <li><strong>Sales Drive & Motivation:</strong> A high degree of self-motivation, strong time management skills, demonstrates initiative and the drive to learn quickly and succeed across both transactional and early-stage strategic sales motions. </li> <li><strong>Collaborative Mindset:</strong> Demonstrated success working with both internal teams and channel partners to ensure seamless customer engagement and shared goal achievement.</li> <li><strong>Digital Proficiency:</strong> Proficiency with core sales technologies, including Salesforce and G Suite, and an ability to use data to prioritise daily activities. </li> <li><strong>Communication & Presence:</strong> Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for engaging with business leaders and maintaining professional business relationships.</li> <li><strong>Resilience & Focus:</strong> A competitive, positive attitude combined with strong organisational and time management skills necessary to handle a dynamic, high-activity territory.</li> <li><strong>Language Skills: </strong>Business Level, written and spoken, German and English language skills required.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Industry Knowledge:</strong> Prior knowledge of the storage industry and familiarity with how data solutions drive business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Channel Sales Expertise:</strong> Understanding of channel-led sales motions and experience collaborating effectively within the broader partner ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Sales Training:</strong> Completion of a structured B2B sales methodology training (e.g., Business Value Selling or similar).</li> <li><strong>Digital Tools:</strong> Experience using digital prospecting and engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to accelerate the sales cycle.</li> </ul> <p>Join Everpure Germany team and be part of a team that's redefining data storage. Apply now and unleash your potential!</p> <p>#LI-OFFICE</p> <h3><br><br></h3><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li> <li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li> </ul> <p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p> <p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p> <p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a ---------- if you’re invited to an interview.</p> <p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p> <p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p> <p>Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.</p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Join us and bring your best.</strong></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Bring your bold.</strong></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Pure and simple.</strong></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. Location: Remote - Germany From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere! We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there. About the Role: As a DevOps Engineer at Sardine, you'll play a critical role in evolving our infrastructure and platform tooling to support a growing engineering team. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll drive key initiatives across deployment, observability, developer productivity, and cloud cost management. You’ll work closely with application engineers, QA, and cross-functional stakeholders like Security and Finance to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient. The role involves building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, improving system observability, optimizing cloud usage through FinOps governance, and strengthening our platform’s resilience. While we have core tools in place, we’re looking for someone who can both own and elevate them by identifying gaps, improving automation, and proactively driving improvements. title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
description: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments. What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare. This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth. The Role We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession. You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes. This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions. You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value. Your Mission Own the full recruiting cycle : from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing. Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor : clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward. Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates , particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles. Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution. Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value. Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy. What Success Looks Like Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous. You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles. Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent , based on evidence rather than titles or impressions. Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation. Your Experience Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus. Proven track record of closing senior, leadership and hard-to-fill searches , with strong active sourcing skills and confidence approaching passive candidates. Experience in a technology-driven, high-growth environment , recruiting across functions such as Product, Technology and Business. You don't need to be technical, but you understand how these teams work well enough to recruit credibly. Experience working directly with founders or demanding senior hiring managers and influencing their decisions rather than simply executing requirements. Experience translating unclear business needs into clear role profiles, scorecards and structured interview processes. Experience selecting and managing external agencies or headhunters . Fluent English ; German is an advantage but not essential. Your Profile You interview for evidence and have strong talent judgment. You can tell an impressive CV or polished answer from real evidence that someone will succeed. You know what good looks like and can credibly bring that standard into an organisation still developing its own. You challenge senior stakeholders constructively and communicate clearly and directly with executives, hiring managers and senior candidates alike. You take ownership. When a search isn't working, you diagnose why and change the approach, and you know when requirements need to change. You create structure without bureaucracy , just enough process to improve speed, quality and accountability. You learn quickly and immerse yourself in unfamiliar domains until you can recruit credibly in them. Why Mindpeak Take real ownership of Talent Acquisition in a growing AI company where hiring exceptional people has a direct impact on the success of the business. Recruit across some of the most interesting talent markets today – from AI and software engineering to medicine, science and commercial roles. Work directly with our founders and senior leaders Shape and continuously improve how we identify, assess and hire exceptional people rather than simply executing a fixed corporate recruiting process. See the impact of the teams you build on cancer diagnostics and treatment. Work from our centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbor. Application Details Please send us: Your CV and reference letters Your salary expectations Your earliest possible starting date Note: Direct applicants only. We do not work with recruiting agencies for this position. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development Representative — VIE  Germany
description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission This VIE is Alta Ares' commercial entry point in Germany — the largest defence market in Europe and one undergoing the most significant defence industrial expansion since reunification. Based in Munich, at the heart of Germany's defence industrial ecosystem (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, ESG, MTU), you will support and drive Alta Ares' early-stage commercial development with German primes and institutional contacts. You will map the ecosystem, build first-contact relationships, and support the Account Manager Germany in converting opportunities into pipeline. Germany's Zeitenwende is real, budgets are moving fast, and the demand for AI and C-UAS capabilities is accelerating. You will be on the ground at the right moment. 1. Market Mapping & Opportunity Identification Map Germany's defence industrial landscape: primes, systems integrators, procurement bodies (BAAINBw, Cyber Innovation Hub der Bundeswehr), and innovation initiatives ( dtec.bw , IDEaS-equivalent) Identify partnership and integration opportunities aligned with Alta Ares' product suite: ISR, C-UAS, AI autonomy Track German defence policy, Bundeswehr procurement priorities, and Zeitenwende investment programmes Produce regular market intelligence reports for the Account Manager Germany and Paris leadership team 2. Relationship Building & Business Development Initiate and develop first-contact relationships with BD, engineering, and procurement teams at target accounts: Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, Diehl, ESG, BWI, and equivalent Support the preparation of partner-facing materials, capability presentations, and meeting briefings Qualify opportunities and escalate concrete prospects to the Account Manager Germany Represent Alta Ares at key German defence events: DSEI, ILA Berlin, Eurosatory, and industry forums in Munich and Berlin 3. Germany–Paris Coordination Serve as the operational bridge between Munich and Alta Ares HQ in Paris Coordinate logistics for partner visits, demos, and leadership trips to Germany Ensure smooth communication across time zones and cultural contexts — translating not just language but business culture Candidate Profile 0–3 years of experience — open to recent graduates and early-career profiles Background in business development, international relations, political science, engineering, or a related field Prior exposure to Germany (studies, internship, or work experience) is a strong plus German fluency — mandatory : your accounts are German industrial companies and relationships are built in German English fluency — mandatory French is a meaningful plus — daily interaction with Paris HQ Genuine interest in defence technology, European security, and Germany's defence industrial ecosystem Organised, proactive, and comfortable building relationships from scratch in a new market Culturally agile: equally at ease in a formal German industrial setting and a fast-moving French startup VIE Eligibility: French or EU nationality — mandatory. Aged 18 to 28 at mission start. No prior VIE with the same company. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Germany
description: About us Complir is the AI platform for the product compliance lifecycle, built for retailers, brands, and manufacturers selling physical consumer products across multiple markets. We believe getting a physical product to market shouldn't mean fighting spreadsheets, PDFs, and supplier emails just to prove it's safe and legal to sell. Product compliance should be continuous, automatic, and understandable - not a bottleneck that slows launches down. We're building the AI infrastructure that makes that possible. We work with many of the worlds largest retailers and brands across fashion, furniture, cosmetics, toys, electronics and many other product categories. We’re backed by Y Combinator, and a roster of investors who see what we see: Product compliance is the next major infrastructure category, and we’re leading it. About the role We're looking for an entrepreneurial salesperson who wants huge responsibility: Bringing Complir to Germany, closing enterprise deals, and shaping our presence in Europe's biggest market. Product compliance is not a topic that makes people lean in at dinner parties. But every product you've ever bought, from your kid's toy dinosaur to your electric toothbrush, had to clear a wall of regulation before it reached you. Most companies manage that wall with spreadsheets, inbox archaeology, and one very tired quality manager. Nowhere is that wall higher than in Germany: the largest consumer market in Europe, home to the manufacturers and brands most exposed to tightening EU regulation, and a market that takes compliance more seriously than anyone. We're fixing this with AI, and we want you to be the person who brings it there. You'll be Complir's first person on the ground in Germany, focused on enterprise: Manufacturers and brands with 1,000+ active products, complex multi-market exposure, and compliance teams drowning in spreadsheets. You'll build your own pipeline and close your own enterprise deals. That means picking up the phone, working your network, and creating opportunities where none existed, with founders and our GTM team behind every deal. We're looking for a self-starting enterprise seller with an entrepreneurial streak - several years of enterprise B2B sales experience, ideally with some background selling into or working in legal, compliance, or regulatory functions. Then comes the second act. As the first customers land, you build the German pod around you: account executives, customer success, eventually a German office with your fingerprints on everything. Germany is the mandate today; Austria and Switzerland follow once Germany works, and the person who built Germany is the natural owner of DACH. Where you'll be based You'll start with 2 weeks at our Copenhagen HQ. This is where you absorb the product, the pitch, and the compliance domain, sitting next to the founders and the GTM team, and where you start building your German pipeline from day one. From there, you're based in Germany, running your own market. You'll be back in Copenhagen for 2 weeks every quarter, working closely with our Head of France and the rest of the team to compare notes across markets, sharpen the playbook, and bring what's working in each country back to your own. What you'll do Own the German market: pipeline, revenue, and everything in between. You build the top of your own funnel using a proven enterprise playbook, adapted to the German market: cold outreach, LinkedIn, events, and channels you develop yourself as you learn what works locally. Run enterprise sales cycles end to end: discovery, demo, pilot, procurement, security review, close Sell to compliance managers, regulatory affairs leads, and C-suite at product companies across categories like cosmetics, toys, and electronics Become an expert in the product compliance space and act as a thought leader within the German product compliance communities Bring market insight back into the product and the pitch: what German enterprises need will shape what we build You will love this job, if you are: An experienced enterprise seller with several years closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B SaaS deals, ideally in the €100k+ ACV range A native-level or full professional German speaker with fluent English. You'll sell in Germany and work internally in English Experienced with (or curious about) selling into compliance, regulatory, quality, or retail. Comfortable being the only Complirian in your market, without being a lone wolf: you'll pull on the founders and product daily Not afraid of picking up the phone. There is no SDR to start off with - the sellers who win are the ones who never stopped picking up the phone A builder at heart What you get Full ownership of Germany, one of Complir’s main markets, with a real say in how it's built The path from first seller to market leader: as Germany grows, you hire and lead the team Be part of a category-defining company, backed by Y Combinator and investors betting on product compliance being the next big thing Competitive salary and equity Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Backend Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany
description: About Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro. Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live. We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape. The role You would be one of our first engineers, building alongside the founding team. At the heart of the product is a stream-first policy engine that evaluates compliance as SQL across past, present and future infrastructure state. It has to be fast, correct and impossible to route around. You'd own large parts of it outright. What you will do Design and build core backend services in Go that evaluate policy against cloud infrastructure changes in real time. Take a core area of the platform and own it end to end, from first design through running it in production. Build the simulation and enforcement path that blocks or auto-remediates non-compliant changes before they reach production. Stay close to customers, see how your work lands in the real world, and fold what you learn back into the product. What we are looking for Strong backend engineering experience in a compiled, statically typed language . We build in Go , so you are either already a Go engineer or someone who will get into it quickly. You know SQL well and think naturally in relational and columnar data models. It’s central to how our engine works. A product mindset. You care about the user and the problem, not only the ticket, and you have opinions about what to build, not just how. A problem-to-solution instinct. You can take an ambiguous problem, find the simple core, and ship something that solves it. End-to-end ownership. You own a problem from design through production and operation, and you see the hard parts through. Hands-on experience operating and running at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure). Not just deploying to it, actually running it: access management, networking or the failure modes. Hands-on with Terraform or Pulumi , and an understanding of how infrastructure-as-code actually behaves in practice. You build with AI coding tools as a normal part of your workflow and have a point of view on where they help and where they don't. We build guardrails for these tools, so we want engineers with deep, hands-on experience in agentic development. Nice to have Background in cloud or cyber security, CSPM, CNAPP, or compliance (e.g. SOC 2, PCI, ISO 27001, GDPR). Experience building policy or rule engines. Experience with high-availability, scaling, and eventually-consistent, event-driven system design. Production experience running Kubernetes clusters. Early-stage startup experience, or having been a founding engineer before. How we work We are remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time. What we offer Real ownership . As an early engineer you design, ship, run and own a genuine surface area of the product, with direct contact with users and a say in how we build. Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it. Competitive salary , benchmarked to the market. A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously. The honest version This is early. Priorities will shift, and some of what you build early will change as we learn. There is no playbook waiting for you. If you want a highly structured environment with a mature codebase and a clear roadmap for the next two years, this is not it. If you want to shape a product and a category from close to the start, and you like the idea of building the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk. title: Response Engineer - Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, United Kingdom </strong></p> <hr> <h2><strong>About the Department</strong></h2> <p><strong>Cloudforce One</strong> is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Email Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service.</li> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD, Formerly SOCaaS):</strong> 24/7 monitoring, detection, and mitigation of security events across Cloudflare products.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> Develops, maintains, and deploys Cloudflare’s threat detection logic across email, application, and network telemetry.</li> </ul> <p>Through the combined capabilities of CMD, PhishGuard, and Detection Engineering, INTERDICT delivers a cohesive operational security function that provides continuous, proactive protection against network, application, and email-based threats. This integrated structure ensures rapid detection, coordinated response, and improved security outcomes for Cloudflare and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The Response Engineer within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center acts as a primary technical responder for Cloudflare's premium enterprise customers. You will autonomously investigate complex threat telemetry, handle live incident response for sophisticated volumetric DDoS and application-layer attacks, and analyze traffic anomalies during high-pressure events.</p> <p>Customers contact the Managed Defense Center for assistance and intelligence across Cloudflare's security portfolio, focused on two core pillars: Web Application Security (WAF and Bot Management) and DDoS mitigation across network and application layers. <br><br>Managed Defense Response Engineers use customer-facing dashboards and internal tools to make detailed and informed suggestions for mitigation, and may implement mitigation strategies directly on behalf of the customer. The team provides continuous proactive monitoring and analysis of security events through internal alerting systems. </p> <p>We are looking for an analytical security practitioner who thrives in this always-on operational environment and bridges the gap between deep technical analysis and premium customer advisory.</p> <h3><strong><em>Role Responsibilities</em></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Implement robust mitigation strategies for complex attacks across OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7 using Cloudflare's suite (Magic Transit, Magic Firewall, Advanced TCP Protection, Advanced DNS Protection, WAF, Custom incidents, driving high-touch, consultative communication (via phone, chat, email) with customers' technical engineering teams to neutralize threats while ensuring stable traffic delivery</li> <li>Continuously tune and optimize existing security monitoring rules and alerting thresholds to improve the operational signal-to-noise ratio and reduce false positives</li> <li>Lead managed customer product, and threat intelligence teams to provide actionable feedback on attack trends, tooling gaps, and product enhancements</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Role Requirements</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>4–7 years of direct, hands-on experience in Managed Detection and Response (MDR), advanced Security Operations, or high-level Technical Support/Incident Response for enterprise infrastructure</li> internet protocols including TCP, UDP, ICMP, GRE, BGP, DNS, with the ability to quickly diagnose attack fingerprints and infrastructure impact during volumetric DDoS attacks</li> <li>Hands-on experience with packet capture (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark, tshark) or HTTP traffic inspection (e.g., HAR, Burp Suite) to analyze malicious traffic</li> <li>Extensive experience managing technical communications with enterprise customers during high-stress, active attacks, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and translate complex attack data into clear actionable advice</li> Next-Gen WAFs, and edge network firewalls) (Preferred)</li> <li>Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments and strong scripting skills (Bash, Python preferred) for workflow automation (including experience leveraging agentic AI environments or LLMs to optimize operations) and experience interacting with REST APIs or GraphQL to pull and correlate operational data (Preferred)</li> <li>Experience building or querying dashboards in Prometheus and Grafana for performance and attack metrics (Preferred)</li> <li>Highly valued security and networking certifications such as GIAC (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GCFE), Cisco CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent hands-on incident response credentials (Preferred)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description: Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach. Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen. Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil. Warum wir? Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht. Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat. Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig. description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness. Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. KI-Tooling ist Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, und du prüfst die Ergebnisse genauso kritisch, wie du sie nutzt. Grundverständnis von Datenbanken (SQL) und API-Design. Du willst verstehen, warum etwas gebaut wird, bevor du es baust. Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit. Echter Impact. Alles, was du baust, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz. Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen.
